messages:
keisha-sales: Prep: big call with AlderTrust tomorrow. Requirements: EU-only processing, BYOK, strict no-cross-border failover during normal ops, and a current subprocessor attestation. Need a short script + ops handoff.

omar-presales: TL;DR: Hosted = regional preference only; Dedicated/Private = can be pinned. BYOK on Dedicated/Private with onboarding.

vik-eng: Hosted note: we cannot promise hard pinning—requests may failover on capacity/DR. Dedicated (reserved pool) = single-region pinning and can set fallback to none. Private = full customer control. BYOK flow: key registration, policy validation, test decrypts, allowlist.

andre-legal: Subprocessors (EU): LogSafe (logs), Observr (metrics), CloudGX (infra). We can provide DPA, subprocessor list, and SOC2/ISO artifacts. Avoid absolute language for Hosted; use "primary" or "preferred".

keisha-sales: Need two short, conservative lines I can read on the call.

vik-eng: Hosted (conservative): "Redwood processes customer workloads primarily in EU regions; in exceptional capacity or recovery events requests may be routed to a compatible region outside the EU; Redwood will notify the customer and offer mitigation options."

vik-eng: Dedicated (conservative): "Redwood will provision and operate dedicated capacity in the customer-specified EU region and restrict processing/storage to that region; only control-plane metadata required for platform health and auditing may be processed outside the region."

andre-legal: Add: "Customer may request a DPA and current subprocessor attestation; Redwood will provide compliance artifacts on request."

jules-pricing: Quick ballpark for procurement: one-time setup ~$37k; committed monthly for a 2x A100 dedicated pool ~$17k/mo; BYOK & attestation add-on ~$4.5k/yr. Final depends on throughput/retention.

keisha-sales: KMS onboarding timeline?

vik-eng: Typical KMS onboarding 7-21 days (key exchange, policy review, test flows). Private/on-prem add 4-6 weeks.

mira-ops: Ops checklist for PROJ-33021 handoff: 1) Confirm EU region (eu-west1/eu-central1) 2) Provide KMS key IDs + rotation policy 3) Subprocessor attestation and DPA request 4) IP allowlist & egress certs 5) Audit log retention and delivery 6) SLA terms and runbook. I'll open ticket.

handoff-bot: Ticket PROJ-33021 created and assigned to @mira-ops.

keisha-sales: Can we show a tiny routing policy example for "pin to region" so customer sees config?

vik-eng: Example (Dedicated pin): {"routing": {"mode": "pin", "region": "eu-west1", "fallback": "none"}} — note: fallback:"none" only for Dedicated/Private. Hosted uses preference + automatic fallback.

omar-presales: I'll lead with the Hosted + Dedicated lines, mention pricing + timeline, and promise PROJ-33021 follow-up with attestation and formal quote. Keisha, post any customer redlines after the call and we'll spin up the quote.
